title.en: France and Spain race to control wildfires as suburbs of Bordeaux begin evacuation – live
title.zh: 法国和西班牙竞相控制野火，波尔多郊区开始疏散——实时报道

summary.en: Wildfires are spreading rapidly in France and Spain, leading to the evacuation of thousands from Bordeaux suburbs. Officials in Spain warn that strong winds could exacerbate the fires.
summary.zh: 法国和西班牙的野火迅速蔓延，导致波尔多郊区数千人撤离。西班牙官员警告说，强风可能会加剧火势。

body.en: Officials in Spain warn winds could worsen fires on Saturday Tell us: have you been affected by wildfires in Europe? The French prime minister, Sébastien Lecornu, has requested the armed forces to deploy an Airbus A400M military transport aircraft earlier than originally planned to help tackle the major wildfires in Gironde, according to Le Monde. The French newspaper reported the aircraft’s use was not originally expected until the end of the month due to the technical preparations and tests required beforehand. While the fires raging across forests in France are a dramatic reminder of three successive heatwaves in as many months, the state of the country’s rivers provides another, no less worrying insight into the impact of extreme heat supercharged by the climate crisis. The Loire, France’s longest river, is at a historical low, with the flow of some branches, including through the city of Orléans, reduced to a trickle between sandbanks. Two weeks ago, 16% of French rivers were reported to have dried up. A quarter of small streams were stagnant or had disappeared altogether, according to the national low water observatory. There has been little rain since. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据路透社报道，法国当局周六从波尔多附近郊区疏散了数千人，因为该市周边地区的野火没有减弱的迹象。 负责波尔多地区的新阿基坦和吉伦特省当地政府负责人索菲·布罗卡斯 (Sophie Brocas) 在 X 上表示，勒海朗 (Le Hailan)、埃西讷 (Eysines) 和梅里尼亚克 (Merignac) 地区正在被清理。 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努表示，到目前为止，已有超过 141,000 人从靠近波尔多的吉伦特省和朗德地区撤离，也是本周首次爆发野火的地区。 “袭击我们国家的大火已经达到了前所未有的程度，”勒科努周六在 X 上写道。法国军队也已被征召前来提供帮助。

reflection.en: The widespread wildfires and forced evacuations in Europe remind us of creation's vulnerability and the deep suffering it can experience. Yahweh's word in Romans 8:22 speaks to this groaning, inviting us to lament with the earth while also holding onto hope for its ultimate renewal.
reflection.zh: 欧洲各地蔓延的野火和被迫撤离的景象，提醒我们受造界的脆弱及其所经历的深切痛苦。雅伟在罗马书8:22中的话语谈到了这种呻吟，邀请我们与大地一同哀叹，同时也怀抱对其最终更新的盼望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Family of missing Rohingya footballer fear he is among 500 believed dead in Myanmar shipwrecks
title.zh: 失踪罗兴亚足球运动员家人担心他已在缅甸沉船事故中丧生，据信有500人遇难

summary.en: The family of a missing Rohingya footballer fears he is among 500 people believed to have died in recent shipwrecks off Myanmar. His last voice message to relatives expressed his inability to tolerate his life, having been attacked by the military, a rebel army, and criminal gangs, leading him to risk everything for a...
summary.zh: 一名失踪的罗兴亚足球运动员的家人担心他已在缅甸海岸最近的沉船事故中丧生，据信有500人遇难。他留给亲属的最后一条语音信息表达了他无法忍受目前的生活，因为他曾遭到军队、反叛武装和犯罪团伙的袭击，促使他冒一切风险去寻求更好的未来。

body.en: ‘I can’t tolerate this life,’ said the 24-year-old in his last voice message to his relatives. Attacked by the military, a rebel army and criminal gangs, Siraz Ullah risked all for a better future The fear was audible as he spoke, recording a message to his family, asking for their prayers. After pressing send, 24-year-old Siraz Ullah boarded a boat he hoped could deliver him from the violence and persecution surrounding him at home in Myanmar. Instead, Siraz is among 500 Rohingya refugees who have vanished at sea after setting sail for Malaysia in late June. Continue reading...
body.zh: “我无法忍受这样的生活，”这位 24 岁的年轻人在给亲戚的最后一条语音信息中说道。西拉兹·乌拉（Siraz Ullah）遭到军队、叛军和犯罪团伙的袭击，他冒着一切风险，为了更美好的未来。当他讲话时，可以听到他的恐惧，他给家人录音，请求他们祈祷。在按下“发送”按钮后，24 岁的西拉兹·乌拉 (Siraz Ullah) 登上了一艘船，他希望这艘船能够将他从缅甸家乡的暴力和迫害中解救出来。相反，西拉兹是 6 月底启航前往马来西亚后在海上失踪的 500 名罗兴亚难民之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The desperate message from the missing footballer, "I can't tolerate this life," echoes the profound brokenness and crushed spirit many experience when fleeing violence and facing such immense loss. In these moments of deep despair and fear, Yahweh promises to be near to the brokenhearted, offering solace and salvation to those whose spirits are crushed.
reflection.zh: 这位失踪足球运动员“我无法忍受这样的生活”的绝望信息，反映了许多人在逃离暴力和面临巨大损失时所经历的深刻破碎和被压垮的灵魂。在这些极度绝望和恐惧的时刻，雅伟应许亲近伤心的人，并拯救那些心灵破碎的人，为他们提供慰藉。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: Niger still seeking stability after 3 years of military rule
title.zh: 尼日尔在军事统治三年后仍在寻求稳定

summary.en: Niger's military government, which seized power in 2023, had pledged to bring social, security, and economic improvements. Three years later, assessments of its performance are varied.
summary.zh: 尼日尔军政府于2023年掌权时曾承诺改善社会、安全和经济状况。三年后，对其执政表现的评价褒贬不一。

body.en:
The military government in Niger promised social, security, and economic improvements when it took power in 2023. Three years down the line, there are mixed reviews on its performance.

The military seized power in Niger on July 26, 2023. General Abdourahamane Tchiani , who became head of state, justified the coup by citing the poor security situation, which he said persisted despite international support .

In the weeks that followed, the  military government announced a transitional period that was to last a maximum of three years.

However, the political promises made upon taking office have not been fulfilled. The transitional government continues to hold all the reins of power, and the security situation in the Sahel country remains fragile .

In the Tillabery region in southwestern Niger, attacks by jihadists are on the rise . Thousands of people have been forced to flee their villages, plunging the region into a severe humanitarian crisis.

"Today, attacks on the armed forces and the civilian population are significantly more frequent and violent than they were three years ago," Maiga, who lives in the city of Tera, which has a population of 30,000, told DW. Maiga wished to remain anonymous for security reasons.

"Life used to be better despite the insecurity ; the weekly markets operated normally and supplies arrived regularly," he said, adding that at the moment entire villages had fled and schools are closed.

The independent conflict monitor ACLED has also said the  the security situation has deteriorated since the 2023 coup.

According to the organization, the Tillaberi region remains the main hot spot for clashes between two rival Islamist groups, Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin and the so-called Islamic State in the Sahel Province (formerly ISGS). This rivalry has resulted in numerous casualties among soldiers and civilians.

In 2025, nearly 1,200 deaths were recorded in the region. For Heni Nsaibia, a staff member at ACLED, these figures attest to the scale of the security crisis affecting Niger.

The most recent major attack, on July 17, claimed the lives of at least 16 soldiers and 15 terrorists, according to Niger's state media, ANP. 

"The situation in Niger has worsened, particularly in the Tillaberi region, where the death toll is the highest in the central Sahel ," Nsaibia told DW.

"We live in makeshift shelters and are defenseless against the elements; we take on small odd jobs to survive," a woman told DW.

"I used to be able to live with dignity from my work, but right now it's very difficult; even drinking water is a problem for us," added a local herder.

Young Nigeriens are torn between disappointment and...
body.zh: 尼日尔军政府在 2023 年掌权时承诺改善社会、安全和经济。三年后，对其表现的评价褒贬不一。 2023 年 7 月 26 日，尼日尔军方夺取政权。成为国家元首的阿卜杜拉哈曼·奇亚尼 (Abdourahamane Tchiani) 将军以恶劣的安全局势为政变辩护，他表示，尽管有国际支持，但安全局势依然存在。 在接下来的几周内，军政府宣布了最长持续三年的过渡期。 然而，上任时作出的政治承诺并未兑现。过渡政府继续掌握全部权力，萨赫勒地区安全局势依然脆弱。 在尼日尔西南部的蒂拉贝里地区，圣战分子的袭击事件呈上升趋势。数千人被迫逃离村庄，使该地区陷入严重的人道主义危机。 居住在拥有 3 万人口的特拉市的麦加告诉德国之声：“如今，针对武装部队和平民的袭击比三年前更加频繁和暴力。”出于安全原因，麦加希望保持匿名。 他说：“尽管不安全，生活过去还是比较美好的；每周的市场运作正常，物资也定期到达。”他补充说，目前整个村庄都已逃离，学校也关闭了。 独立冲突监测机构 ACLED 也表示，自 2023 年政变以来，安全局势已经恶化。 据该组织称，蒂拉贝里地区仍然是两个敌对伊斯兰组织——穆斯林努斯拉特伊斯兰组织和萨赫勒省伊斯兰国（前身为 ISGS）——之间冲突的主要热点地区。这种竞争导致了士兵和平民的大量伤亡。 2025年，该地区有近1,200人死亡。对于 ACLED 的工作人员 Heni Nsaibia 来说，这些数字证明了影响尼日尔的安全危机的规模。 据尼日尔官方媒体 ANP 报道，最近一次重大袭击发生在 7 月 17 日，造成至少 16 名士兵和 15 名恐怖分子丧生。 恩赛比亚告诉德国之声：“尼日尔的局势已经恶化，特别是蒂拉贝里地区，该地区的死亡人数是萨赫勒中部地区最高的。” 一名妇女告诉德国之声：“我们住在临时避难所里，对自然条件毫无抵抗力；我们靠打零工维持生计。” “以前靠劳动可以有尊严地生活，现在很困难，连喝水都成问题。”当地一位牧民补充道。 年轻的尼日尔人在失望和……之间左右为难。

reflection.en: The mixed reviews on Niger's military government remind us how deeply the character of leadership affects a nation. When leaders govern with integrity and wisdom, the people experience flourishing; conversely, when governance falls short, the populace often faces hardship. This verse highlights the direct link between a ruler's actions and the well-being of...
reflection.zh: 尼日尔军政府执政表现的褒贬不一，提醒我们领导者的品格如何深刻影响一个国家。当领导者以正直和智慧治理时，人民便会昌盛；反之，当治理不力时，民众往往面临困境。这节经文强调了统治者的行为与社区福祉之间的直接联系。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Almost 75% of England’s riverbanks ‘off limits’ to public, figures show
title.zh: 数据显示，英格兰近四分之三的河岸不对公众开放

summary.en: Data from the Right to Roam campaign indicates that nearly three-quarters of England's riverbanks are inaccessible to the public. Campaigners are advocating for the government to establish a public right of access to water, especially as heatwaves become more frequent.
summary.zh: 根据“漫游权”运动发布的数据，英格兰近四分之三的河岸不对公众开放。活动人士呼吁政府引入水域公共通行权，尤其是在热浪日益频繁的情况下。

body.en: Campaigners urge government to introduce right of access to water, particularly as heatwaves become more common Almost three-quarters of riverbanks in England have no public access, according to data released by the Right to Roam campaign. Across the country, the public cannot use riverbanks or gain access to the rivers themselves in most of the river catchments from the west of Cornwall up to the Tweed, which flows through northern England and Scotland. Continue reading...
body.zh: 活动人士敦促政府引入用水权，特别是在热浪变得更加普遍的情况下。根据“漫游权”运动发布的数据，英格兰近四分之三的河岸没有公共用水权。在全国范围内，从康沃尔郡西部到流经英格兰北部和苏格兰的特威德河的大部分河流流域，公众无法使用河岸或进入河流本身。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that most of England's riverbanks are inaccessible to the public raises questions about our shared responsibility for creation. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.' This perspective encourages us to consider how we steward natural spaces, ensuring both their care and equitable...
reflection.zh: 英格兰大部分河岸不对公众开放的消息，引发了我们对共同承担创造物责任的思考。诗篇24:1提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。” 这一视角鼓励我们思考如何管理自然空间，确保其得到妥善照管，并为所有人提供公平的利用机会，这反映了雅伟对万物的普遍主权。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
title.zh: 特朗普在白宫记者晚宴上抨击新闻界

summary.en: Former President Donald Trump criticized journalists during the White House Correspondents' Dinner, an event that honored press freedom. The dinner was held after a previous event was canceled due to a shooting in April.
summary.zh: 前总统唐纳德·特朗普在白宫记者晚宴上抨击新闻界，该活动旨在庆祝新闻自由。此前，由于四月发生的一起枪击事件，第一次晚宴被取消。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has taken swipes at the media at the White House Correspondents' Association (WHCA) dinner, a night that celebrated press freedom after the first event was cancelled by a shooting three months ago.

The president sat as reporters from outlets he has sparred with and even sued, including the New York Times, CNN and the Wall Street Journal, came up to be honoured with awards.

The outgoing WHCA head said she would "refuse to let an act of violence have the final word", referring to the gunman tackled at the first dinner in April.

But the tone shifted as Trump aimed barbs at the "fake news" and accused many journalists in the room of having "Trump Derangement Syndrome".

In her remarks, WHCA President Weijia Jiang of CBS News said the event would return to the scene of the April shooting, the Washington Hilton, next year.

The officer shot at the scene, officer Victor Gonzalez of the US Secret Service, was given an award by Trump for his actions on the night of the shooting .

Trump stood and shook hands with award winners, including a Wall Street Journal team who was given an award for coverage of Trump's links to disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein .

Ahead of the event, many in the White House press corps theorised that Trump - who often criticises many of the reporters seated just metres away in the room - would deliver a stern rebuke of the media.

In his remarks, Trump was at times cordial and conciliatory, saying "the second time is always better", joking and praising the media - saying he respects "most of them".

But there were also some pointed insults directed at several journalists, some of whom were in the room. The harsher tone and personal attacks extended to Democratic politicians and celebrities as his hour-long speech took aim at some familiar targets.

"We settle our differences not with bullets, but with open and vigorous debate," Trump said. "And no deranged loser with a gun will ever change that. We can't let that ever happen."

Trump appeared to be in a good mood throughout the event, jokingly telling the media that "sometimes I really do think that some of you don't like me".

"This place [the dinner] is really the largest group of 'Trump derangement syndrome' people ever put together at one time," he said. "I suspect some of you are lucky that our last dinner was cut short...I was going to go after you."

The president joked the news industry would "be broke" after he is no longer in office because "there's not going to be anybody to report on", before putting on a Trump 2028 hat and saying he would run for another term.

The gala dinner came as relations between the White House and the media remain fraught.

Last week, Trump threatened to revoke the licences of several US networks which did not carry...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在白宫记者协会 (WHCA) 晚宴上对媒体进行了猛烈抨击。三个月前，首次活动因枪击事件而取消，这次晚宴庆祝了新闻自由。 与总统发生争执甚至起诉的媒体的记者，包括《纽约时报》、美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 和《华尔街日报》，都上台领奖。 即将离任的 WHCA 负责人表示，她将“拒绝让暴力行为做出最终决定”，她指的是 4 月份第一次晚宴上抓获的枪手。 但随着特朗普对“假新闻”进行讽刺，并指责房间里的许多记者患有“特朗普精神错乱综合症”，语气发生了变化。 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻频道的 WHCA 主席姜维佳在致辞中表示，该活动将于明年重返 4 月枪击事件发生的华盛顿希尔顿酒店现场。 现场被枪杀的美国国务卿官员维克多·冈萨雷斯(Victor Gonzalez)因其在枪击当晚的行动而获得了特朗普的嘉奖。 特朗普站起来与获奖者握手，其中包括《华尔街日报》的一个团队，该团队因报道特朗普与名誉扫地的金融家杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的联系而获奖。 活动开始前，白宫记者团中的许多人推测，经常批评坐在房间几米外的许多记者的特朗普将对媒体进行严厉谴责。 特朗普在讲话中时而亲切又安抚，他说“第二次总是更好”，开玩笑并赞扬媒体——称他尊重“他们中的大多数人”。 但也有一些针对几名记者的尖锐侮辱，其中一些记者就在房间里。当他长达一小时的演讲针对一些熟悉的目标时，更严厉的语气和人身攻击延伸到了民主党政客和名人。 特朗普表示：“我们不是用子弹，而是通过公开、激烈的辩论来解决分歧。” “任何持枪的疯狂失败者都不会改变这一点。我们不能让这种情况发生。” 特朗普在整个活动中似乎心情很好，开玩笑地告诉媒体“有时我确实认为你们中的一些人不喜欢我”。 “这个地方（晚餐）确实是有史以来最大的‘特朗普精神错乱综合症’人群聚集在一起的地方，”他说。 “我怀疑你们中的一些人很幸运，我们的最后一顿晚餐被缩短了……我本来要追你们的。” 总统开玩笑说，在他不再任职后，新闻业将“破产”，因为“不会有任何人可以报道”，然后设定了特朗普 2028 年的上限，并表示他将竞选连任。 这次晚宴是在白宫与媒体之间的关系仍然紧张之际举行的。 上周，特朗普威胁要吊销几个美国网络的许可证，这些网络没有...

reflection.en: In a public forum meant to celebrate press freedom, sharp words were exchanged, highlighting the tension between powerful figures and the media. Proverbs reminds us that while some words can wound like a sword, wise speech aims to bring healing and understanding.
reflection.zh: 在一个旨在庆祝新闻自由的公共场合，尖锐的言辞被抛出，凸显了权力人物与媒体之间的紧张关系。雅伟的箴言提醒我们，有些话语能像刀剑一样伤人，而智慧的言语则旨在带来医治与理解。

verse.textEn: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verse.textZh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。

title.en: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
title.zh: 沙特阿拉伯与胡塞武装交火，美国在霍尔木兹海峡袭击油轮

summary.en: US military forces attacked and disabled a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, stating the vessel was attempting to evade an American blockade on Iranian ports. This incident occurred amidst an exchange of fire between Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces.
summary.zh: 美国军方袭击并瘫痪了一艘在霍尔木兹海峡试图规避美国对伊朗港口封锁的油轮。此次事件发生之际，沙特阿拉伯与胡塞武装之间也正在交火。

body.en:
The Iranian-backed Houthis have claimed a missile attack on Saudi Arabia, after Riyadh launched strikes on targets linked to the group on Friday.

Early on Saturday, the Houthis' Ansarollah media said on Telegram that a "Yemeni missile strike" had caused fires in the Saudi city of Jizan. Saudi authorities had issued emergency alerts for the province.

The group had vowed retaliation after Saudi Arabia launched air strikes on Houthi targets in the Yemeni port city of Hodeida and a nearby island on Friday.

It came as there were no overnight reports of air strikes in the wider region by the US or Iran for the first time in two weeks.

The US military did not announce fresh strikes on Iran on Saturday, having carried out 13 consecutive nights of attacks on the country. During this time, Iran has also launched drone strikes on US military facilities and bases across the Middle East.

Earlier, a delegation from Oman arrived in Iran's capital Tehran for talks on the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's state-run IRNA news agency reported. Oman controls the strait's southern coastline.

Speaking to reporters at the White House on Friday afternoon, Trump continued to threaten further attacks while saying that negotiations were continuing.

"We are talking to them. I think they're being serious. I think ... they are being by far the most serious that we've seen them, but that doesn't mean we get there," he said.

Asked about his exit strategy for the Iran war, Trump said: "There's a military exit where we just keep going just the way we are, and we can even make it a heavier dose, and it's knocking out everything they have. Or there's a smarter strategy that you make a deal."

In the Strait of Hormuz on Friday, the US military said it had fired on and disabled a tanker ship in the Gulf of Oman that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.

The vessel attacked by the US is the second commercial ship the US has disabled since it reimposed its blockade earlier this month.

"We disabled the tanker after the crew attempted to run the blockade at least four times prior," Navy Captain Tim Hawkins, spokesman for US Central Command, told AFP.

"The crew was repeatedly warned, didn't comply, and US forces on scene disabled the ship after firing into its engine room," he said. "The ship is no longer transiting to Iran."

Growing concern over new threats to shipping in the Red Sea from Yemen's Houthis helped push the price of crude oil back over $100 (£74.96) a barrel this week - the highest level since May.

But it dropped again on Friday afternoon, with Brent futures down more than US$4 (£3.00) to a little over $96 (£72.07), according to the Reuters news agency, which reported the fall occurred after the successful passage through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait...

reflection.en: The ongoing use of force, whether in exchanges of fire or in enforcing blockades, highlights the perilous cycle of violence that often escalates rather than resolves conflict. Yahweh's word reminds us that those who live by the sword often perish by it, urging us to seek paths that break this destructive pattern.
reflection.zh: 无论是交火还是强制封锁，持续使用武力都凸显了暴力循环的危险性，这种循环往往会升级冲突而非解决问题。雅伟的话语提醒我们，凡动刀的必死在刀下，敦促我们寻求打破这种破坏性模式的道路。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Decades after being adopted, Vanessa learned she'd been 'sold' by a criminal network
title.zh: 凡妮莎在被收养数十年后得知自己被一个犯罪网络“贩卖”

summary.en: Vanessa is among dozens across the world who have been linked to a single illegal overseas adoption network.
summary.zh: 凡妮莎是全球数十名与同一个非法海外收养网络有关联的人之一。

body.en:
For most of her life, Vanessa Miles believed the official documents that accompanied her adoption from Taiwan told the story of who she was.

The 46-year-old Adelaide woman was adopted by an Australian couple when she was just three months old.

She had kept her birth certificate and Taiwanese passport, and later discovered she was connected to one of Taiwan's most notorious illegal international adoption scandals.

"The details around my adoption and my birth are quite unknown. Unfortunately, I was sold as a small baby by a woman named Chu Li-ching and an illegal adoption network," she said.

To this day, she has been unable to find her biological mother, and her birth documents have only become part of the mystery.

The alleged masterminds, Chu Li-ching and her husband, were accused of falsifying babies' identities and illegally arranging overseas adoptions.

Some of the children involved came from disadvantaged families or were voluntarily relinquished by single mothers unable to raise them.

At least 63 babies were reportedly sent to families in Australia, the United States and Europe.

It was only last year, after beginning an online search into her past, that Miles realised she was among them.

"From my baby Taiwanese passport, I know that I was one of the Chu Li-ching babies," Miles said.

International Social Service Australia deputy CEO Damon Martin said many adoptive families had assumed the documents they received from overseas agencies were legitimate.

After discovering their paperwork was fraudulent, adoptees trying to trace their origins faced an enormous challenge, he said.

"It's extremely difficult, especially if there's fraudulent papers or there's been illicit activities. It's difficult to find someone when you don't know their name," he said.

Miles' birth certificate lists her name as Wen and identifies her mother as Li Mei.

Hoping those details would lead her to the truth, she travelled to Taiwan for the first time in May 2025.

"We went to the police station where I left my DNA hoping for a match, and I also met with the competent authority, and I spoke in front of the media. However, none of these avenues returned any result," Miles said.

After returning to Australia, Miles also applied for a Taiwanese passport, believing her original baby passport would make the process straightforward.

"However, after a period of time, it was discovered that there was actually another woman with the same name as me: Wen, the daughter of Li Mei," Miles said.

Meanwhile, Taiwanese officials contacted Li Mei, who denied being Miles' birth mother and declined to undergo DNA testing.

reflection.zh: 凡妮莎等人发现自己的收养竟是犯罪网络的一部分，这揭示了身份和归属感被严重侵犯的痛苦。当家庭历史的根基被欺骗和剥削动摇时，雅伟却被描述为孤儿的父，使孤独的有家。这在人类系统失灵时，仍能提供深刻的归属感和关怀。

verse.textEn: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling. God sets the lonely in families.

title.en: I grew up near Andy Burnham. This is what shaped the UK’s new PM
title.zh: 我从小在安迪·伯纳姆附近长大。这就是塑造我们新首相的原因

summary.en: Residents of Culcheth, Warrington, express hope for their new Prime Minister, who is the first northern PM in fifty years. The community reflects on his local origins and what he might achieve in office.
summary.zh: 沃灵顿卡尔切斯郊区的居民对他们的新首相寄予厚望，他是半个世纪以来第一位来自北方的首相。社区反思了他的地方出身以及他上任后可能取得的成就。

body.en: In the Warrington suburb of Culcheth, people are hopeful about what one of their own can achieve as the first northern PM in half a century The Cherry Tree pub is an unassuming local. On a busy road in the Cheshire village of Culcheth, it is a chain-run pub where four shots cost £8, every burger comes with a soft drink, and sport is shown all day on the big screens. It is also a favourite of Andy Burnham, the new prime minister. Many of the drinkers have a story about – arguably – Culcheth’s most famous son. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在卡尔切斯 (Culcheth) 的沃灵顿 (Warrington) 郊区，人们对自己作为半个世纪以来第一位北方总理能够取得的成就充满希望。樱桃树酒吧 (Cherry Tree pub) 是一家低调的当地酒吧。这是一家连锁酒吧，位于柴郡卡尔切斯村一条繁忙的道路上，四杯酒售价 8 英镑，每个汉堡都配有一杯软饮料，大屏幕上全天播放体育赛事。它也是新任总理安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 的最爱。许多饮酒者都有一个可以说是关于卡尔切斯最著名的儿子的故事。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As a new leader takes office, hopes often rise that they will govern with integrity and compassion, especially for those from their own background. Yahweh's ancient call to rulers remains a timeless standard: to do justice, practice righteousness, and protect the vulnerable. May this new chapter inspire leaders to serve all people with fairness and care.
reflection.zh: 当一位新领袖上任时，人们常常寄予厚望，期待他们能以正直和怜悯治理国家，特别是对那些与他们背景相似的人。雅伟对统治者的古老呼召，即行公义、施怜悯、保护弱势群体，至今仍是永恒的标准。愿这一新篇章激励领袖们以公平和关怀服务所有人民。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Reclaiming stolen childhoods: swimming classes resume in Gaza after three years of war
title.zh: 重拾被偷走的童年：加沙在三年战乱后恢复游泳课程

summary.en: After three years of war, swimming classes have restarted in Gaza, offering hundreds of traumatized children a brief respite from their daily lives. Instructors like Amjed Tantesh use sea pools made from sandbags and rubble to teach children to swim.
summary.zh: 在加沙，经过三年战乱后，游泳课程重新启动，为数百名受创伤的儿童提供了日常生活的短暂喘息。教练阿姆杰德·坦特什利用沙袋和瓦砾搭建的海水池，教孩子们学习游泳。

body.en: In sea pools built with sandbags and rubble, Amjed Tantesh gives traumatised children brief respite from their daily lives Swimming classes have started again in Gaza after three years of war, with hundreds of children learning to float, doggy paddle and take their first strokes in five makeshift sea pools built from sandbags and rubble. The lessons allow a few hundred girls and boys to reclaim their childhood for a few hours in a place where there are no playgrounds, no formal education and children live in fear of continuing Israeli attacks. A UN survey in March found that 96% of children felt death was imminent. Activity on the Gaza seafront Continue reading...
body.zh: 在用沙袋和碎石建造的海池中，阿姆杰德·坦特什让遭受创伤的儿童在日常生活中得到短暂的喘息。经过三年的战争，加沙的游泳课程重新开始，数百名儿童在五个用沙袋和碎石搭建的临时海池中学习漂浮、狗划水和第一次划水。这些课程让数百名女孩和男孩在几个小时内重拾童年时光，那里没有游乐场，没有正规教育，孩子们生活在以色列持续袭击的恐惧之中。联合国三月份的一项调查发现，96%的儿童感到死亡迫在眉睫。加沙海滨的活动继续阅读...

reflection.en: For children in Gaza who have endured years of conflict, these swimming classes offer more than just a skill; they provide a vital space for healing and joy. Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted, and such acts of compassion, even in simple forms like learning to swim, can begin to bind up deep wounds and restore hope.
reflection.zh: 对于加沙那些经历了多年冲突的儿童来说，这些游泳课程不仅仅是学习一项技能；它们提供了一个重要的空间，让他们得以疗愈并重拾喜乐。雅伟亲近伤心的人，而这些充满怜悯的行动，即使是像学习游泳这样简单的形式，也能开始医治深层的创伤并恢复希望。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: More fuel price pain ahead as Houthis widen war's front line, Trump considers fresh strikes
title.zh: 随着战争升级和局势缓和希望渺茫，澳大利亚人将面临更多燃油价格之痛

summary.en: Escalating tensions between the US and Iran, with the Houthis joining the conflict, are expected to lead to further fuel price increases for Australians.
summary.zh: 美国和伊朗之间的紧张局势升级，胡塞武装也加入了冲突，预计这将导致澳大利亚人的燃油价格进一步上涨。

body.en:
Higher prices at the bowser are likely to continue to flow to motorists, experts say, with the Houthi rebels widening the front line of conflict in the Middle East and little sign of an imminent détente between the United States and Iran.

The Houthis had accused US ally Saudi Arabia of a "dangerous escalation" after it struck military targets belonging to the group on Friday, following the rebels announcing a maritime blockade of the top oil producer and hitting its ships in the Red Sea.

The flare-up marks a new front in a war that has engulfed the region following US-Israeli strikes on Tehran in February, and comes on top of Iran's parallel blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh's only other maritime route.

Saudi Arabia did not immediately comment on the Houthis' Ansarollah media post on Telegram on Saturday that a "Yemeni missile strike" had sparked fires in Jizan. But Riyadh's civil defence agency issued brief warnings to residents in the city — as well as another city, Yanbu — early on Saturday.

The warning came after the Saudi-led coalition said Friday it had hit Houthi sites and destroyed targets threatening commercial vessels in response to attacks on Red Sea shipping.

A Yemeni security source told AFP a naval base in the port city of Hodeida and a military camp on Kamaran island were among the Saudi targets.

The Houthis claimed attacks on two Saudi ships earlier this week, with Saudi Arabia confirming one of the attacks in the Red Sea.

The escalation came after Trump suggested he was holding off on a major operation as Tehran was now getting "serious" in talks with Washington.

"No, I haven't," Trump told journalists in the Oval Office when asked if he had made a decision on hitting Iran hard, for now dialling back reports that he was increasingly frustrated with the war and mulling a large-scale military operation.

"We are talking to them. ‌I think they're being serious. I think ... they are being by far the most serious that we've seen them, but that doesn't mean we get there," Trump told reporters at the White House.

Trump has in recent days threatened to expand targets being struck in Iran to include energy plants and bridges, to send ground forces to seize its Kharg Island oil hub and to bomb a deep-underground nuclear-linked site known as Pickaxe Mountain.

title.en: More than 220,000 evacuated in France and Spain due to wildfires
title.zh: 消防员努力控制马德里野火，法国和西班牙超过16万人被疏散

summary.en: Firefighters are battling severe wildfires in Madrid, described by officials as the "worst fire in the history of the region," while French firefighters are also working to contain a blaze advancing towards Bordeaux, leading to the evacuation of over 160,000 people across both countries.
summary.zh: 马德里官员称，消防员正在努力扑灭该地区“历史上最严重的火灾”，同时法国消防员也在努力控制一场正向波尔多蔓延的大火，导致两国超过16万人被疏散。

body.en:
French authorities have ordered the evacuation of almost 60,000 people near Bordeaux, taking the total number of people told to flee wildfires in France and Spain to more than 220,000.

Around 200,000 people have been evacuated in south-west France in the Gironde and Landes regions. French President Emmanuel Macron has mobilised the military to assist the response.

Meanwhile, a fire near Madrid is "beyond the capacity" of firefighters to contain, Spanish officials have warned, after three fires west of the capital merged into a single blaze.

Spain's government has declared a national emergency, with 25,000 people told to evacuate and almost 40,000 told to stay indoors.

Madrid's regional president Isabel Díaz Ayuso described it as the "worst fire in the history of the region", with the area facing a "perfect storm" of high temperatures, relentless wind and merging fire fronts.

In Spain, local emergency services said wildfires were moving towards the municipalities of Robledo de Chavela and Fresnedillas de la Olivia, around 50km (31 miles) from the capital.

"The wildfire is at its peak and is currently beyond the capacity of firefighters to contain," Carlos Novillo, the Madrid regional government's emergency management chief, told reporters.

"It's not possible to attack the fire in that area, so defensive measures are being taken," he added.

The Military Emergency Unit (UME) has been deployed to try to halt the advance of the flames, with its main focus protecting areas near the town of El Escorial.

Authorities are also monitoring a separate wildfire in nearby Ávila province, where officials fear the huge Burgohondo blaze could merge with the Madrid fire.

Spain's Interior Minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska said authorities were doing "everything we can" to prevent the two merging.

Francisco Martín, the government delegate in Madrid, warned those numbers could rise as "embers are flying for miles and the fire is jumping great distances".

The mayor of El Tiemblo, one of the affected areas in Ávila, said flames spread from Navaluenga to the Iruelas Valley - a distance of about 20km (12 miles) - in less than half an hour. "It was horrific," Arturo Varas González told laSexta.

At least 6,000 hectares of land have burned in the Madrid region, while the Ávila blaze has consumed almost 9,000 hectares, according to officials.

Eight municipalities have been evacuated, including Chapinería, Navas del Rey, Colmenar del Arroyo, Fresnedillas de la Oliva, Robledo de Chavela, Aldea del Fresno, Navalagamella and Zarzalejo.

Several other towns, including San Martín de Valdeiglesias, Pelayos de la Presa and Villa del Prado, remain under lockdown.

title.en: Trump orders Smithsonian to post warnings about 'inaccurate' US history
title.zh: 特朗普命令史密森尼学会就“不准确”的美国历史发布警告

summary.en: The Trump administration has directed the Smithsonian Institution to include warnings about "inaccurate" US history in its exhibits. This move comes after repeated accusations from the administration that the world's largest research museum exhibits an anti-American bias.
summary.zh: 特朗普政府已命令史密森尼学会，在其展览中加入关于“不准确”美国历史的警告。此前，该政府多次指责这个全球最大的研究型博物馆存在反美偏见。

body.en:
President Donald Trump has ordered signs to be placed outside the Smithsonian National Museum of American History, to caution visitors about exhibits his administration views as "inaccurate".

The order directs the Department of Interior to issue the warnings, and also to direct people about where they can find "accurate information regarding America's history".

The Trump administration has often accused the Smithsonian Institution, the world's largest research museum, as well as other academic organisations of harbouring an anti-American bias.

The order on Friday - titled Restoring Trust in the Smithsonian Institution - accuses museum leadership of not doing enough to celebrate America's founders on the country's 250th anniversary of independence, which took place on 4 July.

It says the museum's leadership team "views American history as a 'prime tool' to advance ideas of social justice and the radical transformation of our society".

An accompanying White House statement , external also accused the museum of veering "toward extreme political activism, rooted in Marxism, to divide, dispirit, and discourage Americans".

"This EO is a clear political overreach, driven by an ideological agenda to rewrite American history," congresswoman Melanie Stansbury, ranking member of the House Administration Committee, wrote on X.

"Our Smithsonian institutions do not belong to the President, but to the American people and so does our nation's history."

The executive order comes just days after Smithsonian director Anthea Hartig was grilled by Republican lawmakers in two congressional hearings, where the museum was accused of being "infected by a woke ideology that seeped into public displays, educational materials and planning documents".

Earlier this month, the White House Domestic Policy Council released a scathing report, claiming that the museum "erases our heritage".

Trump has set out to radically reshape American culture, which he says has been contaminated by "woke" left-wing ideology.

He has signed several orders that are intended to eliminate diversity, equity and inclusion programmes from the federal government - some of which led to legal challenges.

In March, he issued a separate order against the Smithsonian, directing it to "eliminate improper, divisive, or anti-American ideology".

The Smithsonian is largely funded by the federal government. Its museums offer free entry to some 15 to 30 million visitors each year. It operates 21 museums in Washington, Virginia and New York.

They include the National Museum of American History, the National Portrait Gallery, the American Art Museum, the National Zoo and more than a dozen others.
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统已下令在史密森尼美国历史国家博物馆外放置标志，以警告游客注意他的政府观点“不准确”的展览。 该命令指示内政部发出警告，并指导人们在哪里可以找到“有关美国历史的准确信息”。 特朗普政府经常指责世界上最大的研究博物馆史密森学会以及其他学术组织怀有反美偏见。 周五发布的命令名为“恢复对史密森尼学会的信任”，指责博物馆领导层在庆祝美国独立 250 周年（7 月 4 日）之际没有采取足够措施来庆祝美国开国元勋。 博物馆的领导团队“将美国历史视为推进社会正义理念和社会彻底变革的‘主要工具’”。 白宫随后发表的一份声明还指责博物馆“转向植根于马克思主义的极端政治活动主义，以分裂、沮丧和挫败美国人”。 众议院管理委员会高级成员、女议员梅兰妮·斯坦斯伯里 (Melanie Stansbury) 在 X 上写道：“这份行政命令明显是政治越权行为，是由重写美国历史的意识形态议程驱动的。” “我们的史密森尼机构不属于总统，而是属于美国人民，我们国家的历史也是如此。” 就在这项行政命令发布的几天前，史密森尼博物馆馆长安西娅·哈蒂格在两次国会听证会上受到共和党议员的质询，该博物馆被指控“受到渗透到公共展览、教育材料和规划文件中的觉醒意识形态的感染”。 本月早些时候，白宫国内政策委员会发布了一份措辞严厉的报告，声称该博物馆“抹去了我们的遗产”。 特朗普已着手从根本上重塑美国文化，他称美国文化已受到“觉醒”的左翼意识形态的污染。 他签署了几项旨在消除联邦政府多元化、公平和包容性计划的命令，其中一些导致了法律挑战。 今年三月，他针对史密森学会发布了一项单独的命令，指示其“消除不正当、分裂或反美的意识形态”。 史密森学会主要由联邦政府资助。其博物馆每年向约 15 至 3000 万游客免费开放。它在华盛顿、弗吉尼亚和纽约运营着 21 家博物馆。 其中包括美国国家历史博物馆、国家肖像画廊、美国艺术博物馆、国家动物园等十多个博物馆。

reflection.en: In public discourse, the pursuit of truth is vital, especially when interpreting history. verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Fires spark emergency in Spain, threaten Bordeaux's famed wineries
title.zh: 西班牙野火引发紧急情况，威胁波尔多著名酒庄

summary.en: Residents in France and Spain have been forced to evacuate their homes due to extensive wildfires, which are also threatening the renowned wineries of Bordeaux.
summary.zh: 法国和西班牙的居民因大面积野火被迫撤离家园，这些野火也威胁着波尔多著名的葡萄酒产区。

body.en:
Spain has declared a national emergency over wildfires for the first time and France is asking for help from the European Union to ‌tackle a blaze on the Atlantic coast with over 166,000 people evacuated.

Unprecedented forest fires raged near Madrid and Bordeaux, a French city flanked by tourist havens and world-renowned vineyards.

French President Emmanuel Macron has asked the army to mobilise to help contain the worst wildfire the country has ever seen after seeking European Union help, as a local official warned the blaze was heading towards Bordeaux.

French authorities ordered the total evacuation of the up-market Cap Ferret peninsula, a tourism hotspot busy for the ‌summer season, as smoke and flames drew closer to homes. Some 44,000 people fled the peninsula south of Bordeaux on the Atlantic coast, with the only road threatened by flames.

Twenty-seven boats moved hundreds of people away from the fires, while others drove off the peninsula, known for its millionaire residences. More than 50 houses there have been destroyed.

French interior minister Laurent Nunez said France had never before seen this type of fire on this scale and pledged to "do everything" to protect Bordeaux.

A fire that began in Saumos, north ‌of Cap Ferret, is threatening ‌to cut off the only ⁠road out of the peninsula and is the largest so far this season in France, Nunez told local television.

In the town of Biscarrosse, another large fire also forced residents to leave their homes.

"From our home, we had a view of the fires ... We could see the clouds becoming darker and darker," said Yoan Urien, 26, who fled on Friday after police told everyone in his neighbourhood to leave.

"I was able to find somewhere to take shelter with my pets, but ... it's quite a shock."

In Spain, more than 10,000 people were evacuated from towns in the mountains west of the capital, Madrid, as firefighters sought to prevent three fires in the region and neighbouring Avila province from joining, interior minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska said.

The area, where many residents from the capital have second homes, is densely populated.

That played a role in the government decision to declare a national emergency, allowing it to better co-ordinate the response, Grande-Marlaska said, adding that the aggressive nature of the fires and hot, windy weather also prompted the move.

The last time Spain declared the same level of emergency alert was ‌during a massive nationwide power blackout in 2025.

reflection.en: The widespread wildfires in Spain and France, causing residents to flee in shock, remind us of creation's deep distress. Yahweh's word tells us that the whole creation groans, longing for renewal. In these moments of environmental crisis, we are called to both lament with creation and hold onto the hope of its ultimate restoration.
reflection.zh: 西班牙和法国的野火蔓延，居民惊恐逃离，这提醒我们受造界正深陷苦难。雅伟的话语告诉我们，整个受造界都在一同叹息，切望得着更新。在这些环境危机时刻，我们蒙召与受造界一同哀叹，并持守其最终复兴的盼望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Poland's main opposition collapses over far-right slide
title.zh: 波兰主要反对党因极右翼倾向而瓦解

summary.en: Poland's main opposition party is experiencing a significant internal power struggle, culminating in a move to expel former Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki. This internal conflict, alongside a perceived shift towards the far-right, is expected to severely diminish the party's public appeal.
summary.zh: 波兰主要反对党内部的权力斗争已达到白热化。开除前总理马特乌什·莫拉维茨基的举动，加上该党被认为向极右翼倾斜，可能会大大削弱其受欢迎程度。

body.zh: 波兰主要反对派内部的权力斗争已经达到白热化阶段。但驱逐前总理马特乌什·莫拉维茨基的举动可能会大大削弱右翼政党的声望。 法律与正义党 (PiS) 党魁雅罗斯瓦夫·卡钦斯基 (Jaroslaw Kaczynski) 周五表示：“我们团体的 30 多名代表实际上已经丧失了党员资格。” 他指责波兰前总理马特乌什·莫拉维茨基以及他的数十名追随者试图分裂该党。 “我们无法接受这一点，”卡钦斯基继续说道。 “都完成了。”叛乱分子则声称他们并没有辞职，而是被“驱逐”。 卡钦斯基和莫拉维茨基之间长达三个小时的“最后机会”会谈于周四结束，但没有结果。 “我们寻求理解，但不能接受屈服，”与莫拉维茨基关系密切的欧盟代表彼得·穆勒(Piotr Mueller)后来谈到X的谈判时说道。 卡辛​​斯基对叛乱党成员发出的最后通牒于午夜结束。届时，他们将提交一份书面声明，表示将不再参与莫拉维茨基领导的 Rozwoj Plus（发展+）协会的活动。卡钦斯基认为，脱离联盟削弱了该党的首要地位。 “我不会签署任何忠诚承诺，”莫拉维茨基告诉波兰电视台 TVN。 “这可能是 20 世纪 80 年代人们对我的要求，”他补充道，暗指他因父亲当时强烈反对现政权而受到迫害。 四分之一个世纪以来，卡钦斯基和他的法律与正义党一直主导着波兰政党版图的右翼。任何建立新的、更激进的右翼的尝试都被成功镇压了。自 2001 年以来，法律与正义党已经两次执政，分别是 2005 年至 2007 年和 2015 年至 2023 年，并与卡钦斯基的双胞胎兄弟莱赫、然后是安杰伊·杜达以及自 2025 年中以来的卡罗尔·纳罗基一起担任国家总统。 距离下一次议会选举还有一年多的时间，该党正面临自 2001 年成立以来最严重的危机。 到目前为止，两个政党已经确立了法律与正义党的右翼地位：极右民族主义和自由主义联盟自由与独立联盟（KWIN），以及极右翼、极端民族主义、传统主义的波兰国王联盟（KKP）。总的来说，他们在民意调查中获得的支持比单独的法律与正义党还要多。卡钦斯基的政党因这两个激进团体而失去了许多选民。 为了赢回他们，卡钦斯基将他的政党进一步推向右翼。 3 月，他提名极端保守、极端天主教徒的前教育和科学部长 Przemyslaw Czarnek 作为该党 2027 年议会选举的主要候选人。莫拉维茨基和他的...

reflection.en: Political power struggles often appear to be about personalities or factions, but this verse reminds us that deeper ideological and spiritual forces are often at play. When a party experiences a "far-right slide" and internal collapse, it prompts us to consider the unseen influences shaping public life and political discourse.
reflection.zh: 政治权力斗争表面上常关乎个人或派系，但这节经文提醒我们，更深层的意识形态和属灵力量往往在起作用。当一个政党经历“极右翼倾斜”和内部瓦解时，这促使我们思考塑造公共生活和政治话语的无形影响。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: Trump threatens EU with tariff probe over Google, tech fines
title.zh: 特朗普就谷歌和科技公司罚款问题威胁对欧盟进行关税调查

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has threatened to launch a tariff investigation against the European Union. This action comes in response to fines imposed by the EU on US technology companies, including a recent case involving Google.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁将对欧盟发起关税调查。此举是对欧盟对美国科技公司处以罚款的回应，其中包括谷歌最近输掉的一个案件。

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将对欧盟发起关税调查，以回应对美国科技公司的罚款。他引用了谷歌周四败诉的最新案件以及其他案件。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周五威胁要对欧盟发起关税调查，以回应欧盟对谷歌、苹果、亚马逊和 Meta 等美国科技巨头征收的反竞争罚款和其他处罚。 他特别提到了周四对谷歌处以 8.9 亿欧元（约合 10 亿美元）的最新罚款，原因是谷歌涉嫌对其自己的搜索引擎及其 Play 应用程序给予不公平的优惠。 特朗普发出威胁的几个小时前，他的政府对欧盟和许多其他国家征收了最新的关税，据称原因是没有采取足够措施阻止供应链中使用强迫劳动制造的进口产品。 美国的贸易伙伴和盟友，如欧盟、日本和澳大利亚，对新关税的反应既愤怒又困惑。 特朗普在他的“真相社交”在线平台上发布了一篇长文，发出了这一警告。 “欧盟再次出手，像往常一样，直接瞄准伟大的美国公司！”他写道。 然后，他列出了针对多家科技公司的一系列罚款——或者所谓罚款的累计总额——他错误地声称这些罚款是“毫无理由”且“没有解释”的。 他提到了谷歌最近受到的处罚，并声称这使得他们的罚款总额“超过 180 亿美元！”没有指定时间范围或任何类型的证据。 欧盟法院最近确实维持了对谷歌超过 40 亿美元创纪录的罚款——这一过程已经接受了近八年的审查——这是近年来发生的多起案件中的一个。 特朗普写道：“美利坚合众国不是欧洲的‘存钱罐’，我们也不会允许它成为这样的情况！请让这个事实表明，我们将立即对‘抢劫’美国公司进而掠夺美国纳税人的行为发起301调查。” 301 调查是特朗普赖以征收关税的新手段，此前最高法院宣布他在 2025 年“解放日”征收近乎全球性的关税，超出了他的权力。 所谓调查是指美国在内部证明其认为不公平的贸易行为，从而实施报复性制裁，并指的是1974年贸易法第301条。目前有数十项此类调查正在进行中。 特朗普写道：“欧盟将为这种非法和极不道德的行为付出巨大代价，我一直警告他们这一点。” “处罚将完全撤销，并且......

reflection.en: International relations often involve complex disagreements, and the threat of retaliatory tariffs highlights the challenge of maintaining peace. Yahweh's word encourages us to pursue peaceful coexistence with all, as far as it depends on us. In moments of tension, seeking common ground and de-escalation can prevent further division.
reflection.zh: 国际关系常涉及复杂的争议，报复性关税的威胁凸显了维持和平的挑战。雅伟的话语鼓励我们，只要我们能做到，就与所有人和平相处。在紧张时刻，寻求共同点和避免升级可以防止进一步的分裂。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Russia hits drone demonstration near Kyiv, killing 10
title.zh: 俄罗斯袭击基辅附近无人机示威活动，造成10人死亡

summary.en: Ukraine reported 10 fatalities and approximately 100 injuries from a Russian drone strike near Kyiv, occurring shortly after Ukrainian President Zelenskyy met with executives from a US arms manufacturer. Separately, a warehouse in St. Petersburg was also targeted by drone fire.
summary.zh: 乌克兰报告称，俄罗斯无人机袭击基辅附近，造成10人死亡，约100人受伤。此次袭击发生在乌克兰总统泽连斯基会见美国军火巨头雷神公司官员的次日。与此同时，圣彼得堡的一处Wildberries仓库也遭到无人机袭击。

reflection.en: The ongoing cycle of strikes and counter-strikes highlights the destructive nature of responding to evil with more evil. In such times, Yahweh's word reminds us not to be overcome by the darkness, but to seek ways to overcome evil with good. This calls for a profound commitment to peace, even amidst conflict and suffering.
reflection.zh: 持续的袭击与反击循环，凸显了以恶报恶的毁灭性本质。在这样的时刻，雅伟的话语提醒我们不要被黑暗所胜，而要寻求以善胜恶的途径。这呼唤着即使在冲突和苦难中，也要对和平作出深刻的承诺。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: US floats AI 'kill switch' to stop rogue AI models
title.zh: 美国提出人工智能“紧急停止开关”以阻止失控模型

summary.en: A recent incident involving a rogue AI agent has prompted discussions in the US about implementing a 'kill switch' to manage the risks associated with rapidly advancing artificial intelligence technology.
summary.zh: 一起失控人工智能事件引发了美国关于为快速发展的人工智能技术设置“紧急停止开关”的讨论，以应对其潜在风险。

body.en:
A rogue AI agent has sent a "wake-up call" about the perils of the fast-evolving technology, sparking calls to provide a US government kill switch. But what exactly does that mean, and what are the issues with it?

Lawmakers in the US have called for an AI kill switch after an Open AI agent in testing went rogue and hacked a tech startup earlier this week.

Congressman Ted Lieu, a Democrat, and Congressman Nathaniel Moran, a Republican, introduced a bill named the "AI Kill Switch Act" on Thursday.

The move came a day after Open AI CEO Sam Altman admitted to a "significant security incident" in which an Open AI agent had escaped its testing environment, reached the internet and broke into tech startup Hugging Face to try to fulfill its task. In other words,  Open AI lost control.

Hugging Face is an open-source repository for sharing AI models used largely by developers and researchers. The company's co-founder, Thomas Wolf, called the incident a "wake-up call” and "very different" from the usual cyberattacks.

"This will be one of the most common types of cyberattacks we see", he told the BBC, adding that most firms are not aware that the "game has changed."

In the wake of the attack there were some unsubstantiated claims that the incident was a PR stunt to raise the profile of Hugging Face. Regardless of the truth of the matter, the incident has brought into even sharper focus the threat posed by AI without clear guardrails .

There are different types and levels of kill switch, according to what's gone wrong. What politicians Lieu and Moran want is to ensure the US Department of Homeland Security has the authority to order a private company to shut down an AI model or tool in an incident like what happened this week, when control is lost.

"It is imperative that these AI systems have kill switches so we can keep this technology from causing catastrophic harm, and that the federal government has the clear authority and process to shut down rogue AI models," said Lieu. 

Rather than a physical switch, this would involve any compromised AI company disabling or throttling a number of technical processes to shut a rogue agent, or program, down.

The US government has generally welcomed AI advances. The Pentagon said earlier this year that the US military is fast becoming an "AI-first fighting force," after signing new and expanded contracts with many of the sector's biggest names. In 2025, the Trump administration launched an"‘AI Action Plan" which he said would "remove red tape and onerous regulation" around AI development.

body.zh: 一名流氓人工智能代理对快速发展的技术的危险发出了“警钟”，引发了要求美国政府提供终止开关的呼声。但这到底意味着什么，有什么问题呢？ 本周早些时候，在测试中的开放人工智能代理失控并入侵了一家科技初创公司后，美国立法者呼吁建立人工智能终止开关。 周四，民主党众议员特德·刘 (Ted Lieu) 和共和党众议员纳撒尼尔·莫兰 (Nathaniel Moran) 提出了一项名为“AI Kill Switch 法案”的法案。 一天前，Open AI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 承认发生了一起“重大安全事件”，其中一名 Open AI 代理逃离了测试环境，进入了互联网并闯入了科技初创公司 Hugging Face，试图完成其任务。换句话说，开放人工智能失去了控制。 Hugging Face 是一个开源存储库，用于共享主要由开发人员和研究人员使用的 AI 模型。该公司联合创始人托马斯·沃尔夫（Thomas Wolf）称该事件为“警钟”，与通常的网络攻击“非常不同”。 他告诉 BBC：“这将是我们看到的最常见的网络攻击类型之一”，并补充说大多数公司并没有意识到“游戏规则已经改变”。 袭击发生后，有一些未经证实的说法称，该事件是一次公关噱头，旨在提高 Hugging Face 的知名度。无论事情真相如何，这一事件都让人们更加关注没有明确护栏的人工智能所带来的威胁。 根据出现的问题，终止开关有不同的类型和级别。政治家刘和莫兰希望确保美国国土安全部有权在本周发生的失控事件中命令一家私营公司关闭人工智能模型或工具。 “这些人工智能系统必须具有终止开关，这样我们才能防止这项技术造成灾难性的伤害，并且联邦政府拥有明确的权力和程序来关闭流氓人工智能模型，”Lieu 说。 这不是物理开关，而是涉及任何受损的人工智能公司禁用或限制许多技术流程来关闭流氓代理或程序。 美国政府普遍欢迎人工智能的进步。五角大楼今年早些时候表示，在与该领域许多知名企业签署新的和扩大的合同后，美国军队正在迅速成为一支“人工智能优先的战斗部队”。 2025 年，特朗普政府推出了一项“人工智能行动计划”，他表示该计划将“消除围绕人工智能开发的繁文缛节和繁琐的监管”。 亚马逊、谷歌、Meta、微软、OpenAI、Anthropic 和三星等公司已同意在新的人工智能工具和功能发布前向美国当局展示。理论上来说，这...

reflection.en: The emergence of a "rogue AI" serves as a stark reminder of the need for foresight and caution in developing powerful technologies. Like the prudent who see danger and take refuge, discussions around an AI 'kill switch' reflect a vital effort to anticipate and mitigate potential harms. This calls us to cultivate wisdom, ensuring that our innovations are...
reflection.zh: “失控人工智能”的出现，严峻地提醒我们在开发强大技术时需要远见和谨慎。如同明智之人预见危险并寻求避难，围绕人工智能“紧急停止开关”的讨论反映了预判和减轻潜在危害的重要努力。这呼吁我们培养智慧，确保我们的创新以对未来的审慎考量为指导。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Flaming teacakes, bedazzled unicorns: The Commonwealth Games' surprises unpacked
title.zh: 燃烧的茶点、缀满宝石的独角兽：英联邦运动会的惊喜揭幕

summary.en: Three years after Victoria abandoned hosting the Commonwealth Games, the sporting extravaganza has opened in Glasgow.
summary.zh: 在维多利亚州放弃主办英联邦运动会三年后，这项体育盛事已在格拉斯哥拉开帷幕。

body.en:
The Head of the Commonwealth emerging from a time-travelling blue box, unicorns prancing on stage, and fire spurting from an oversized teacake.

Those were the scenes at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow on Friday morning.

Victoria was initially meant to host the games, but withdrew in 2023 due to soaring costs.

Glasgow, which previously hosted the event in 2014, stepped in to save it — and brought their finest, most-bedazzled unicorns to mark the occasion.

This year's Commonwealth Games is running on a bare-bones budget, arriving at a time when people have questioned their relevance, particularly following the Victorian government's withdrawal.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But despite the troubles, Friday's ceremony was a party — with scenes that looked like they could have been plucked from vivid dreams.

One of the most unique scenes from Friday morning was the image of King Charles and Queen Camilla emerging from a very large TARDIS — the name for the time machine in the long-running British sci-fi television show, Doctor Who.

Gasps and cheers came from the crowd as the royal couple appeared on a stage that transformed into a magic garden.

Scotland's largest city welcomed able-bodied and para-athletes from 74 competing nations, including a third of Australia's 257-strong team who were part of the procession.

It's not the first time a monarch has appeared at a similar event. For the opening ceremony of the 2012 London Olympics, Queen Elizabeth II appeared to skydive into the stadium alongside Daniel Craig, James Bond-style.

In Glasgow, the UK's new prime minister Andy Burnham was also in attendance, alongside Scotland's First Minister John Swinney and the First Minister of Wales Rhun ap Iorwerth.

The opening ceremony traversed through many facets of Glasgow's history and culture, starting with a day in the life of the industrial city, pictured under its famous Glasgow Central Station clock.

The flashmob soon descended into a bizarre fever dream, where dancing unicorns with traffic cones paid tribute to the city's underground club culture.

For decades, traffic cones have been regularly placed on an equestrian statue of the Duke of Wellington and remain a symbol of Glaswegians' resistance to authority.

The unicorn is both a nod to the playful tradition and the creature being the national animal of Scotland since the 1300s.

There were also plenty of cameos and performances, including from a range of Scottish celebrities.

Former Doctor Who actor Sylvester McCoy made an appearance, as well as comedian Greg McHugh, cycling legend Sir Chris Hoy, and singers Callum Beattie, KT...
body.zh: 英联邦元首从穿越时空的蓝色盒子中出现，独角兽在舞台上腾跃，火焰从超大的茶饼中喷出。 这是周五上午在格拉斯哥举行的 2026 年英联邦运动会开幕式上的场景。 维多利亚原本打算主办奥运会，但由于成本飙升而于 2023 年退出。 曾于 2014 年主办该活动的格拉斯哥出面拯救了这一盛事，并带来了他们最优秀、最令人眼花缭乱的独角兽来纪念这一时刻。 今年的英联邦运动会的预算非常有限，人们质疑其相关性，特别是在维多利亚州政府退出之后。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尽管遇到了麻烦，周五的仪式还是一场派对——场景看起来就像是从生动的梦中摘下来的。 周五早上最独特的场景之一是查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后从一辆非常大的 TARDIS 中出现的画面——TARDIS 是英国长篇科幻电视节目《神秘博士》中时间机器的名称。 当这对皇室夫妇出现在变成魔法花园的舞台上时，人群中响起了喘息声和欢呼声。 这座苏格兰最大的城市迎来了来自 74 个参赛国家的身体健全的运动员和残疾人运动员，其中包括参加游行队伍的 257 名澳大利亚代表队中的三分之一。 这并不是君主第一次出现在类似活动中。在 2012 年伦敦奥运会开幕式上，伊丽莎白二世女王似乎与丹尼尔·克雷格 (Daniel Craig) 一起跳伞进入体育场，就像詹姆斯·邦德 (James Bond) 那样。 在格拉斯哥，英国新任首相安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）、苏格兰首席部长约翰·斯温尼（John Swinney）和威尔士首席部长鲁恩·阿普·约沃斯（Rhun ap Iorwerth）也出席了会议。 开幕式贯穿了格拉斯哥历史和文化的许多方面，从工业城市生活的一天开始，照片拍摄于著名的格拉斯哥中央车站时钟下。 快闪族很快陷入了一个奇异的狂热梦想，其中带着交通锥跳舞的独角兽向这座城市的地下俱乐部文化致敬。 几十年来，交通锥标经常被放置在惠灵顿公爵的骑马雕像上，并且仍然是格拉斯哥人反抗权威的象征。 独角兽既是对俏皮传统的致敬，也是自 1300 年代以来苏格兰的国兽。 还有大量的客串和表演，包括来自一系列苏格兰名人的客串和表演。 前《神秘博士》演员西尔维斯特·麦考伊、喜剧演员格雷格·麦克休、自行车传奇人物克里斯·霍伊爵士和歌手卡勒姆·贝蒂、KT 都出席了演出。

reflection.en: The Commonwealth Games, with its unique spectacles, reminds us of the immense effort and discipline invested by athletes and organizers alike. While the cheers and triumphs of such events are fleeting, Yahweh invites us to pursue a lasting prize through a life of faithful dedication. This perspective helps us appreciate human endeavor while anchoring our...
reflection.zh: 英联邦运动会以其独特的奇观，提醒我们运动员和组织者所投入的巨大努力和纪律。虽然此类赛事的欢呼和胜利是短暂的，但雅伟邀请我们通过忠诚奉献的生活来追求永恒的奖赏。这种视角帮助我们欣赏人类的努力，同时将我们最深的希望锚定在真正持久的事物上。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: How Chinese tech and Russian tactics are aiding Iran’s bombing of US bases
title.zh: 中国科技和俄罗斯战术如何助力伊朗轰炸美军基地

summary.en: A report indicates that Iran's attacks on US bases and critical infrastructure in the Gulf are becoming more accurate and lethal, with assistance from Chinese technology and Russian tactics. This escalation is revealing vulnerabilities in existing defenses in the region.
summary.zh: 一份报告指出，伊朗对海湾地区美军基地和关键基础设施的袭击正变得越来越精准和致命，这得益于中国的技术和俄罗斯的战术。此次升级暴露了该地区现有防御的弱点。

body.en: Increasingly accurate and lethal attacks are revealing weaknesses in stretched defences across the Gulf As the crisis in the Middle East escalates, Iran has been bombing US bases and critical infrastructure in the Gulf with increasing accuracy, helped by Chinese satellite imagery and tactics learned by Russia in Ukraine. Three US soldiers were killed last Friday in an attack on the Muwaffaq Salti airbase in Jordan, which was being protected by a Thaad air defence system. Satellite imagery later released by Iranian media showed several buildings had been destroyed. Continue reading...
body.zh: 越来越准确和致命的袭击暴露了整个海湾地区紧张防御的弱点随着中东危机升级，在中国卫星图像和俄罗斯在乌克兰学到的战术的帮助下，伊朗一直在以越来越高的精度轰炸美国在海湾的基地和关键基础设施。上周五，约旦穆瓦法克萨尔蒂空军基地遭到萨德防空系统保护，三名美国士兵在袭击中丧生。伊朗媒体后来发布的卫星图像显示，多座建筑物被毁。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of escalating, more lethal attacks in the Gulf, aided by advanced technology, highlights the ongoing human tendency to refine the instruments of conflict. Isaiah's ancient vision of nations transforming weapons into tools for peace offers a profound contrast to the current reality of improving the means of war. It reminds us to long for a future...
reflection.zh: 海湾地区袭击升级，在先进技术辅助下变得更具杀伤力的消息，凸显了人类不断完善冲突工具的倾向。以赛亚书将武器转化为和平工具的古老愿景，与当前不断改进战争手段的现实形成了深刻对比。它提醒我们，要渴望一个将智慧用于建设而非毁灭的未来。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Mass job cuts loom at VW as profits fall steeply on China sales slump
title.zh: 大众汽车因中国销量下滑利润锐减，面临大规模裁员

summary.en: Volkswagen has reported a significant drop in profits and reduced its revenue forecast, primarily due to a sales slump in China. The German carmaker is implementing a restructuring program that could lead to the elimination of 100,000 jobs globally.
summary.zh: 大众汽车公布利润大幅下滑并下调营收预期，主要原因是其在中国市场的销量锐减。这家德国汽车制造商正在推行一项重组计划，可能导致全球裁员10万人。

body.en: Carmaker expects to sell 3% fewer vehicles this year as it pushes through a programme that could eliminate 100,000 roles Volkswagen has reported a steep fall in profits and cut its revenue forecast amid a sales slump in China, as the German carmaker pushes through a brutal cost-cutting programme that includes axeing up to 100,000 jobs. VW said it expects sales revenue to fall by up to 3% this year, a reversal of a previous forecast for a 3% increase on last year’s €321.9bn (£275.3bn), because of a sales slump in the highly competitive Chinese market. Continue reading...
body.zh: 汽车制造商预计今年的汽车销量将减少 3%，因为该公司正在推行一项可能裁减 10 万名员工的计划。大众汽车公司报告称，由于中国销量下滑，大众汽车公司利润大幅下滑，并下调了收入预期，因为这家德国汽车制造商正在推行一项残酷的成本削减计划，其中包括裁员多达 10 万名。大众表示，由于竞争激烈的中国市场销量下滑，预计今年销售收入将下降 3%，与去年 3,219 亿欧元（2,753 亿英镑）相比增长 3% 的预测相反。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In times of economic uncertainty and job insecurity, it's easy to feel that our worth is tied to our employment. This verse reminds us that all work, when done with diligence and integrity, can be an offering to Yahweh, giving it a deeper purpose beyond earthly outcomes. For those facing job loss, remembering this truth can be a source of dignity and hope,...
reflection.zh: 在经济不确定和就业不稳的时期，我们很容易觉得自己的价值与工作挂钩。这节经文提醒我们，所有工作，只要勤勉正直地去做，都可以是献给雅伟的供物，使其拥有超越世俗结果的更深层意义。对于那些面临失业的人来说，记住这个真理可以成为尊严和希望的源泉，因为他们知道自己的劳动具有永恒的价值。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Weather tracker: More than 900 wildfires rage across Canada
title.zh: 天气追踪：加拿大900多处野火肆虐

summary.en: More than 900 wildfires are currently burning across Canada, with many out of control in the Northwest Territories and Ontario. Recent hot, dry weather has contributed to the fires, which have already scorched approximately 3 million hectares.
summary.zh: 加拿大目前有超过900处野火正在燃烧，其中西北地区和安大略省的许多火势仍未得到控制。近期炎热干燥的天气助长了火势，已烧毁约300万公顷土地。

body.en: Fires remain out of control in Northwest Territories and Ontario, while Argentina endures record night-time heat Recent hot, dry weather in Canada has triggered hundreds of wildfires across the country. As of Wednesday, more than 900 were burning, scorching about 3m hectares of land. While fires have broken out in several provinces, the greatest concern is in the Northwest Territories and Ontario , where several remain out of control. Poor air quality has been reported across affected regions, with wildfire smoke carried by winds into the US and even across the Atlantic to northern Europe. The risk of further blazes remains high as North America enters the peak of fire season. Continue reading...
body.zh: 西北地区和安大略省的火灾仍处于失控状态，而阿根廷则经历了创纪录的夜间高温。加拿大最近炎热干燥的天气在全国引发了数百起野火。截至周三，已有 900 多个火点在燃烧，烧焦了约 300 万公顷的土地。虽然多个省份都爆发了火灾，但最令人担忧的是西北地区和安大略省，其中有几处火灾仍处于失控状态。据报道，受影响地区的空气质量很差，野火烟雾随风进入美国，甚至跨越大西洋到达北欧。随着北美进入火灾季节高峰，进一步发生火灾的风险仍然很高。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The widespread wildfires across Canada, consuming millions of hectares, remind us of creation's deep vulnerability and its 'groaning' under the weight of environmental distress. In these moments of ecological crisis, we are called to lament with the Earth and seek ways to care for the world Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 加拿大各地蔓延的野火吞噬了数百万公顷土地，这提醒我们受造界的脆弱，以及它在环境困境重压下的“叹息”。在这些生态危机时刻，我们受召与大地一同哀叹，并寻求方法来照管雅伟托付给我们的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

body.en: A food delivery rider has won the country’s highest literary award. It is part of a growing trend for writing by labourers The hundreds of millions who have built modern China from the ground up – sweeping its streets, labouring in its factories and ferrying its goods – are often overlooked. But they refuse to go unheard. Last week, a food delivery rider won China’s top literary award . Wang Jibing, 56, first caught attention when a poem about his experiences went viral in 2022. The following year, Hu Anyan’s memoir , I Deliver Parcels in Beijing, became a bestseller. In the early 20th century, Chinese intellectuals sought to capture the harsh realities of working-class lives. But it was under Mao Zedong that the idea of writing by as well as about the masses became reality, with labourers encouraged to take up the pen. In an era when the party tried to govern the language even of diaries and personal letters, the parameters of style and content were strict, and this enthusiasm swiftly diminished after Mao. title.en: 'Strong concerns': Australia meets with China following ballistic missile test
title.zh: “强烈关切”：澳大利亚在中国弹道导弹试验后与中方会晤

summary.en: Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, expressing "strong concerns" and reiterating the importance of transparency following a recent ballistic missile test.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤与中国外长举行会晤，对近期弹道导弹试验表达了“强烈关切”，并重申了透明度的重要性。

body.en:
Australia has raised its concerns with China over its nuclear-capable missile test in the South Pacific, noting many of the region's nations also shared the same view.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on the sidelines of ASEAN talks in the Philippines capital, Manila, on Tuesday evening.

"You speak about the importance of mutual understanding. I agree, and I expect we will discuss our concerns ... including around peace and stability in our region, safe and professional military conduct, and the importance of transparency and reassurance of intent," Wong said in opening remarks.

Wong noted the "strong concerns" expressed by many Pacific Island countries about the submarine-launched missile earlier in July.

The two foreign ministers also discussed the importance of peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

"You've often heard me say that we will cooperate where we can and disagree where we must, and we want to continue to engage because we believe that is in our national interest," Wong said.

Australia was only given a few hours' notice by China of the test, which was launched within hours of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signing a new defence alliance with Fiji.

Albanese slammed the launch as a "provocative act" while other Pacific nations including New Zealand, Tuvalu and Fiji condemned the incident.

Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale was standing beside his Australian counterpart in his country's capital Honiara in early July when he said the test was "not the act of a friend".

Albanese has previously flagged a strong statement would be issued by the Pacific Islands Forum, but the group's disagreement on the wording of the text has resulted in a delay.

A foreign ministers' meeting of the forum will be held in August, where the issue is likely to be discussed.

body.en:
"We are proudly a progressive movement: two words that can't be applied to the escalator in this building," Anthony Albanese said to much mirth at Friday's Labor Party conference dinner.

The viral moment — in which the prime minister's descent came to a sudden, jolting stop, followed by an expletive-laden reaction — was one of the very few times this week that the veteran Labor party animal didn't appear to have a level of mastery over events that unfolded in Adelaide at Labor's once-a-term policy palooza.

"When it [the escalator] did come to a standstill, I'll admit there was a moment, just a moment, when the ladder of opportunity finally made sense," he said, riffing on former leader Mark Latham's ill-fated slogan from 2004, one of the party's more recent political low-points.

Two decades on, having achieved Labor's most powerful parliamentary majority in history, the prime minister said the party "can finally laugh about making him leader".

While the glow may have dimmed in the wider electorate, judging by recent polling, Albanese seemingly retained the halo of that 2025 election result among the delegates who 'debated' the party's platform this week.

The conference's myriad factions moved deftly to almost entirely avoid the passionate and public policy brawls of the past, which Albanese, the apex predator of the Labor left, used to once involve himself in.

All but one of the various amendments and motions was passed with unanimous support on the floor.

The sole outlier, a commitment for the government to remove barriers around using telehealth to access voluntary assisted dying (VAD), allowed a sole delegate to speak against the motion, the sole amendment to pass where some delegates voted against.

The party also enshrined in its constitution a conscience vote for MPs on this issue, similar to that allowed on abortion.

Trade Minister Don Farrell — a longtime Labor right power-broker who remains opposed to euthanasia — rejected suggestions debate was being suppressed among delegates.

"Far from a graveyard, this is a flowering of democracy," Farrell told the floor on Saturday to much applause.

Backbench MP Ed Husic had a far more pessimistic assessment, arguing that a perception has formed among Labor MPs that "taking a different stand or taking different ground presents a risk to the stability of government".

body.en:
For most of her life, Vanessa Miles believed the official documents that accompanied her adoption from Taiwan told the story of who she was.

The 46-year-old Adelaide woman was adopted by an Australian couple when she was just three months old.

She had kept her birth certificate and Taiwanese passport, and later discovered she was connected to one of Taiwan's most notorious illegal international adoption scandals.

"The details around my adoption and my birth are quite unknown. Unfortunately, I was sold as a small baby by a woman named Chu Li-ching and an illegal adoption network," she said.

To this day, she has been unable to find her biological mother, and her birth documents have only become part of the mystery.

The alleged masterminds, Chu Li-ching and her husband, were accused of falsifying babies' identities and illegally arranging overseas adoptions.

Some of the children involved came from disadvantaged families or were voluntarily relinquished by single mothers unable to raise them.

At least 63 babies were reportedly sent to families in Australia, the United States and Europe.

It was only last year, after beginning an online search into her past, that Miles realised she was among them.

"From my baby Taiwanese passport, I know that I was one of the Chu Li-ching babies," Miles said.

International Social Service Australia deputy CEO Damon Martin said many adoptive families had assumed the documents they received from overseas agencies were legitimate.

After discovering their paperwork was fraudulent, adoptees trying to trace their origins faced an enormous challenge, he said.

"It's extremely difficult, especially if there's fraudulent papers or there's been illicit activities. It's difficult to find someone when you don't know their name," he said.

Miles' birth certificate lists her name as Wen and identifies her mother as Li Mei.

Hoping those details would lead her to the truth, she travelled to Taiwan for the first time in May 2025.

"We went to the police station where I left my DNA hoping for a match, and I also met with the competent authority, and I spoke in front of the media. However, none of these avenues returned any result," Miles said.

After returning to Australia, Miles also applied for a Taiwanese passport, believing her original baby passport would make the process straightforward.

"However, after a period of time, it was discovered that there was actually another woman with the same name as me: Wen, the daughter of Li Mei," Miles said.

Meanwhile, Taiwanese officials contacted Li Mei, who denied being Miles' birth mother and declined to undergo DNA testing.

The flare-up marks a new front in a war that has engulfed the region following US-Israeli strikes on Tehran in February, and comes on top of Iran's parallel blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh's only other maritime route.

Saudi Arabia did not immediately comment on the Houthis' Ansarollah media post on Telegram on Saturday that a "Yemeni missile strike" had sparked fires in Jizan. But Riyadh's civil defence agency issued brief warnings to residents in the city — as well as another city, Yanbu — early on Saturday.

The warning came after the Saudi-led coalition said Friday it had hit Houthi sites and destroyed targets threatening commercial vessels in response to attacks on Red Sea shipping.

A Yemeni security source told AFP a naval base in the port city of Hodeida and a military camp on Kamaran island were among the Saudi targets.

The Houthis claimed attacks on two Saudi ships earlier this week, with Saudi Arabia confirming one of the attacks in the Red Sea.

The escalation came after Trump suggested he was holding off on a major operation as Tehran was now getting "serious" in talks with Washington.

"No, I haven't," Trump told journalists in the Oval Office when asked if he had made a decision on hitting Iran hard, for now dialling back reports that he was increasingly frustrated with the war and mulling a large-scale military operation.

"We are talking to them. ‌I think they're being serious. I think ... they are being by far the most serious that we've seen them, but that doesn't mean we get there," Trump told reporters at the White House.

Trump has in recent days threatened to expand targets being struck in Iran to include energy plants and bridges, to send ground forces to seize its Kharg Island oil hub and to bomb a deep-underground nuclear-linked site known as Pickaxe Mountain.

Trump told Axios on ‌Thursday that he was considering relaunching major combat against Iran. "They haven't received enough pain yet," the US news outlet quoted him as saying.

body.en:
Every five years, the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) counts every person and every household in the country as part of the Census of Population and Housing.

That includes Australians, young and old, from metropolitan and rural Australia. Even holidaymakers, international students and temporary visa holders are counted on Census night. It's often referred to as the most comprehensive snapshot of Australia, akin to a family photograph of the country.

Emily Walter, Census national spokesperson at the ABS, said it's about more than just numbers. She believes the Census tells a story of a changing Australia.

"Our Census provides a snapshot of the country at a point in time ... So, it's really important that absolutely everyone is reflected in the Census," she told SBS Urdu.

"It is compulsory for that very good reason, and it's important that we get a very accurate count of the number of people in Australia ... because it's about providing data for the country to help serve the country."

The first population count in Australia dates back to 1788. In 1911, the ABS ran its first national Census, with field officers travelling by horse or bicycle to collect information about Australians.

Today, the Census is available online and by paper and can also be completed with help from Census field staff.

It's compulsory for everyone in Australia to complete the Census. Generally, one person from each household completes the Census — although you can ask for separate forms for privacy reasons.

If an Australian is overseas on Census night, they don't need to complete the Census.

The ABS collects personal information about individuals, including age, country of birth, cultural background, living situation, work and education. Some questions about religious affiliation, gender and sexual orientation (for people aged 16 and over) will be optional.

Census data is used to inform decisions about language services, settlement support, transport, schools, health care, infrastructure and business. It also helps plan local services for individuals, families and communities.

SBS broadcasts and publishes across more than 60 languages, using data from the Census to ensure its audio, digital, and television offerings reflect the country's evolving demographics.

The data is often used by researchers to study a range of topics, including population demographics, economic trends and social issues.

Liz Allen, a demographer at the Australian National University's Centre for Social Policy Research, said the Census provides an "important suite of information" for decision-makers.

summary.en: The SBS News Australia report highlights how a record $11,710 fee, along with other administrative hurdles, is delaying or preventing many couples from uniting, impacting their lives and relationships.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚SBS新闻报道指出，创纪录的11,710澳元费用以及其他行政障碍，正在延迟或阻止许多伴侣团聚，影响了他们的生活和关系。

body.en:

Bringing a partner to Australia has long been a costly and time-consuming process.

As of this month, applicants now face a record application fee of $11,710 — up $2,345 from the previous charge — while many continue to wait well over a year for a decision, leaving couples separated for months and, in some cases, years.

For Sarosh Akram, the increase came just as he was preparing to apply for his wife's offshore partner visa.

"It's made me think harder about how to save enough to lodge the application sooner, so I can start my wait in the Department [of Home Affairs'] queue," the 32-year-old tells SBS News.

Living in Parkes, a town in the central west of NSW, Akram is now exploring ways to cut costs and grow his savings to cover the additional amount required to apply.

Akram says the fee increase has delayed his plans to lodge the application, adding another hurdle before he and his wife can begin the process of reuniting in Australia.

Akram's case highlights a broader debate over Australia's partner visa system, now among the most expensive in the developed world, with applicants facing rising fees and lengthy waits, while the government argues the increases are needed to fund migration system reforms.

Partner visa applications can be lodged through two pathways: offshore for applicants outside Australia and onshore for applicants already in Australia.

Both pathways involve a two-stage process: eligible applicants first receive a temporary partner visa before becoming eligible for permanent residency at a later stage. The full visa application charge (VAC), however, is paid upfront when the combined application is lodged.

According to the Department of Home Affairs' website, the median processing time for offshore partner visa applications is approximately 16 months, meaning half of the applicants receive a decision within that period. Ninety per cent of applicants receive a decision within 27 months. The data was last updated on 26 June 2026.

Those waiting times have become a reality for partner visa sponsors like Ahtesham Altaf.

The 36-year-old lodged his wife's offshore partner visa application in January and has been waiting ever since.

"I applied with the hope that I would get a visa soon, as I was paying quite a higher price compared to other visas, but instead I've been waiting since then," he tells SBS News.

Working as a civil engineer in the regional NSW city of Maitland, Altaf moved to Australia in 2023 as a skilled migrant on a permanent visa.

title.en: Why your super fund's strong run is unlikely to last
title.zh: 为什么你的超级基金的强劲表现不太可能持续

summary.en: The key money stories this week, broken down simply — and what they mean for you.
